latest_build.description: The latest available build number. App prompts an optional update when current build < this value.

min_supported_build.description: Minimum supported build number. App forces an update when current build < this value. Set to 0 to disable forced updates.

store_url.description: Play Store / App Store URL opened when the user taps the update button.

ads_enabled.description: Show banner ads in the app. Flip to true to enable ads without an app release.
